reply.text:
Good to have you back — day one back after years off is supposed to leave a mark, that's your body waking back up, not damage. General soreness like that usually settles with easy movement, some walking, protein, and sleep. If anything is sharp, local to a joint, or getting worse rather than better, that's a question for a doctor or physio, not me.

For day 2, go ahead and train — just don't chase the same muscles as hard if they're still trashed. Want me to look at what your plan has lined up next?
